morning-1.title: Morning Supplication
morning-1.meaning: O Allah, by You we enter the morning and by You we enter the evening, by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the resurrection.

protection-1.title: Supplication for Protection
protection-1.meaning: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in the heavens can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

forgiveness-1.title: Seeking Forgiveness
forgiveness-1.meaning: I seek forgiveness from Allah the Almighty, besides whom there is no god, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all, and I repent to Him.

gratitude-1.title: Supplication of Gratitude
gratitude-1.meaning: Praise be to Allah who has fed us, given us drink, sufficed us and given us shelter.

evening-1.title: Evening Supplication
evening-1.meaning: O Allah, I ask You for the good of this night and the good of what it contains, and I seek refuge in You from its evil and the evil of what it contains.

sleep-1.title: Before Sleeping
sleep-1.meaning: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.

wakeup-1.title: Upon Waking Up
wakeup-1.meaning: Praise be to Allah who gave us life after He had caused us to die, and to Him is the resurrection.

stress-1.title: Supplication in Distress
stress-1.meaning: There is no god but You. Glory be to You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.

travel-1.title: Supplication for Travel
travel-1.meaning: Glory be to Him who has subjected this to us, and we could never have done it ourselves. And indeed, to our Lord we will surely return.

health-1.title: Supplication for Health
health-1.meaning: O Allah, grant me health in my body. O Allah, grant me health in my hearing. O Allah, grant me health in my sight.

knowledge-1.title: Supplication for Knowledge
knowledge-1.meaning: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

guidance-1.title: Supplication for Guidance
guidance-1.meaning: O Allah, guide me and keep me on the right path.

patience-1.title: Supplication for Patience
patience-1.meaning: Our Lord, pour upon us patience and make our steps firm.

food-1.title: Before Eating
food-1.meaning: O Allah, bless what You have provided us and protect us from the punishment of the Fire. In the name of Allah.

parents-1.title: Supplication for Parents
parents-1.meaning: My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up when I was small.

success-1.title: Supplication for Success
success-1.meaning: My Lord, expand for me my chest and ease for me my task.

anger-1.title: When Angry
anger-1.meaning: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the accursed.

mosque-1.title: Entering the Mosque
mosque-1.meaning: O Allah, open for me the doors of Your mercy.

mosque-2.title: Leaving the Mosque
mosque-2.meaning: O Allah, I ask You of Your bounty.

rain-1.title: When It Rains
rain-1.meaning: O Allah, make it a beneficial rain.

fear-1.title: Supplication in Fear
fear-1.meaning: Allah is sufficient for me. There is no god but Him. In Him I put my trust, and He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne.

exam-1.title: Supplication Before an Exam
exam-1.meaning: My Lord, increase me in knowledge and understanding, and join me with the righteous.

illness-1.title: Supplication for Healing
illness-1.meaning: Remove the harm, O Lord of mankind, and heal, for You are the Healer. There is no healing but Your healing, a healing that leaves no illness behind.

debt-1.title: Relief from Debt
debt-1.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief, from incapacity and laziness, from miserliness and cowardice, from the burden of debt and from being overpowered by people.

repentance-1.title: Master of Seeking Forgiveness
repentance-1.meaning: O Allah, You are my Lord. There is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I abide by Your covenant and promise as best I can.

1.content: Your Lord has said: Call upon Me; I will respond to you.

2.content: Actions are judged by intentions, and everyone will have what they intended.

4.content: The best of you are those who learn the Quran and teach it.

5.content: Allah does not burden a soul beyond what it can bear.

6.content: Make things easy and do not make them difficult; give glad tidings and do not drive people away.

7.content: Indeed, Allah is with those who are patient.

8.content: Love of this world is the root of every wrongdoing.

9.content: Verily, in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.

10.content: Whoever guides someone to good will have a reward like the one who does it.

11.content: Man shall have nothing but what he strives for.

12.content: The best of people are those most beneficial to others.

13.content: He who created death and life to test you as to which of you is best in deeds.

15.content: Indeed, the most noble of you in the sight of Allah is the most righteous of you.

isra-82.content: And We send down of the Quran that which is healing and mercy for the believers.

rad-28.content: Verily, in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest and tranquility.

insirah-5-6.content: Indeed, with hardship comes ease. Indeed, with hardship comes ease.

mumin-60.content: Your Lord has said: Call upon Me; I will respond to you.

duha-3.content: Your Lord has not forsaken you, nor is He displeased.

bakara-286.content: Allah does not burden a soul beyond what it can bear.

taha-114.content: And say: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

zumer-53.content: Say: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah.

yunus-57.content: O mankind, there has come to you instruction from your Lord, healing for what is in the hearts, and guidance and mercy for the believers.

suara-80.content: And when I am ill, it is He who cures me.

talak-3.content: And whoever relies upon Allah, then He is sufficient for him.

fussilet-44.content: Say: It is, for those who believe, a guidance and a healing.

bakara-186.content: And when My servants ask you concerning Me, indeed I am near. I respond to the call of the caller when he calls upon Me.

tebve-128.content: There has certainly come to you a Messenger from among yourselves. Grievous to him is what you suffer; he is concerned over you and to the believers is kind and merciful.

furkan-74.content: Our Lord, grant us from among our spouses and offspring comfort to our eyes, and make us leaders for the righteous.

aliimran-173.content: Sufficient for us is Allah, and He is the best Disposer of affairs.

esma: The One God, who unites all names and attributes of perfection.
The Most Compassionate, merciful to all creation in this world.
The Most Merciful, especially to the believers in the Hereafter.
The King, the Owner of the dominion of the universe.
The Most Holy, free from every imperfection.
The Source of Peace, who grants safety to His servants.
The Giver of Security and Faith.
The Guardian, who watches over and protects all things.
The Almighty, whom none can overcome.
The Compeller, whose will is always done.
The Supreme in Greatness.
The Creator, who brings into being from nothing.
The Maker, who creates in perfect harmony.
The Fashioner, who gives everything its form.
The Ever-Forgiving, who covers sins.
The Subduer, who prevails over everything.
The Bestower, who gives freely and abundantly.
The Provider of sustenance to all.
The Opener, who removes hardship and opens the doors of good.
The All-Knowing.
The Withholder, who restricts provision as He wills.
The Expander, who extends provision as He wills.
The Abaser, who lowers whom He wills.
The Exalter, who raises whom He wills.
The Giver of Honour.
The Giver of Dishonour.
The All-Hearing.
The All-Seeing.
The Judge, whose decree is final.
The Utterly Just.
The Subtle and Kind, who knows the finest details.
The All-Aware.
The Forbearing, gentle with His creation.
The Magnificent, beyond comprehension.
The All-Forgiving.
The Appreciative, who rewards little deeds greatly.
The Most High.
The Most Great.
The Preserver, who protects all things.
The Sustainer, who gives nourishment to all.
The Reckoner, who takes account of His servants.
The Majestic.
The Most Generous.
The Watchful, who observes all at every moment.
The Responsive, who answers prayers.
The All-Encompassing in knowledge, mercy and power.
The All-Wise.
The Most Loving.
The Most Glorious.
The Resurrector of the dead.
The Witness, present everywhere.
The Truth, the Real.
The Trustee, who best arranges the affairs of His servants.
The All-Strong.
The Firm, whose power is unshakeable.
The Protecting Friend of the believers.
The Praiseworthy.
The Counter, who knows the number of all things.
The Originator, who begins creation.
The Restorer, who brings back to life.
The Giver of Life.
The Bringer of Death.
The Ever-Living.
The Self-Subsisting Sustainer of all.
The Finder, who lacks nothing.
The Noble, abundant in generosity.
The One, unique in essence and attributes.
The Eternal Refuge, whom all depend upon.
The All-Capable.
The All-Powerful, who disposes over all who have power.
The Expediter, who brings forward whom He wills.
The Delayer, who holds back whom He wills.
The First, without beginning.
The Last, who remains after all perishes.
The Manifest, evident through His signs.
The Hidden, whose essence is unseen.
The Governor, who alone manages the universe.
The Most Exalted.
The Source of Goodness.
The Accepter of Repentance.
The Avenger, who justly punishes wrongdoers.
The Pardoner.
The Most Kind and Compassionate.
The Eternal Owner of all dominion.
The Lord of Majesty and Generosity.
The Equitable, who does all things with justice.
The Gatherer, who gathers what He wills when He wills.
The Self-Sufficient, the Infinitely Rich.
The Enricher.
The Preventer, who withholds what He does not will.
The Creator of harm (as a test).
The Creator of benefit.
The Light, who illuminates the worlds.
The Guide to the right path.
The Incomparable Originator of beauty.
The Everlasting.
The Inheritor, the ultimate Owner of all.
The Guide to Rightness, whose affairs are perfectly directed.
The Most Patient, who does not hasten punishment.
